synthesizedFacts.fact: Non-surgical treatments for cheek wrinkles, such as Ultherapy and dermal fillers, offer benefits like reduced recovery time, lower cost, and fewer risks compared to surgical options.
Wrinkles form due to a combination of natural aging, loss of collagen and elastin, and external factors like sun exposure and smoking.
Prescription-strength retinoids can reduce fine wrinkles and improve skin texture, but they may cause skin irritation and increase sun sensitivity.
Botox injections are effective for dynamic wrinkles and require repeat treatments to maintain results.
